start.label: Göbel's construction
start.holders: Frits Göbel: the Göbel strip 30 + 1/2*sqrt(2) of n = 912, less 2 of its squares

reports.holders: Kirill Tymchishin, Vladislav Lavrentev and Francisco Couzo

rulings.text: A side below an earlier report at its count by less than one unit in the 12th place, with both rounding up to the same 12-place print, restates that report: the earlier report stays the row, and the later side is not recorded.

Göbel's classical constructions are earlier reports beyond n = 324: at each count the least side of the three families the Kingbird catalogue states, at that count or by deleting squares from a larger one, joins the start, so a side at or above it is not recorded.
